name: indahl-relay
description: Run multi-stage unattended work (training ladders, eval sweeps, data pipelines) as a chain of stages with dependencies, machine lanes, exit codes recorded to files, explicit blocked states and an optional end-of-run handoff. Runs locally. Nothing is sent anywhere unless a stage you write sends it.
